items.title: Memory may not work how we thought, study of mice in artificial hibernation finds
items.summary: A new study induced artificial hibernation in lab mice and may have revealed something fundamental about the nature of memory.
items.zh: 对人工冬眠小鼠的研究发现，记忆可能并不像我们想象的那样运作

items.title: Saving old trees may protect people's health more than planting new ones, study of Chicago neighborhoods finds
items.summary: A study tracking tree cover in Chicago over 11 years found that neighborhoods losing canopy saw death rates climb, especially in the city's hottest areas.
items.zh: 对芝加哥社区的研究发现，保存老树比种植新树更能保护人们的健康

items.title: The glue that binds a proton may be key to its identity
items.summary: Gluons do more than hold protons together. They may also help define the proton’s identity through a quantum property called baryon number.
items.zh: 结合质子的胶水可能是其身份的关键

items.title: 'They basically used these dried-up wells just to throw people in': 43 skeletons found in Roman-era well may be evidence of deadly plague
items.summary: Archaeologists have analyzed dozens of skeletons from a mass burial in a well. The lack of injuries suggests the people may have died from a plague rather than a battle.
items.zh: “他们基本上只是用这些干涸的井把人扔进去”：在罗马时代的井中发现的 43 具骷髅可能是致命瘟疫的证据

items.title: New AI technique helps robots complete tasks twice as fast by letting them 'think ahead'
items.summary: A new AI system lets robots plan their next move while they're in motion — removing reaction delays and doubling task speeds without any extra computing overhead.
items.zh: 新的人工智能技术通过让机器人“提前思考”，帮助机器人以两倍的速度完成任务

items.title: Stars’ plasma spurts may be blocked by magnetic fields
items.summary: The sun frequently flings plasma into space, but sightings of such eruptions on other stars are rare. Magnetic fields could explain why.
items.zh: 恒星的等离子体喷发可能会被磁场阻挡

items.title: James Webb telescope just spotted the oldest, closest pair of black holes in the early universe
items.summary: The dual black hole system, dubbed LID-1166, is the first close-separation pair of its kind confirmed this early in the universe. The discovery could help to explain how the earliest black holes grew so large, so fast.
items.zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯望远镜刚刚发现了早期宇宙中最古老、最近的一对黑洞

items.title: Foodborne illnesses: Is the US really being hit harder this year?
items.summary: While parasitic Cyclospora infections have reached record-breaking numbers this year, experts have criticized coverage that has created the appearance of "one massive outbreak." The reality is more nuanced.
items.zh: 食源性疾病：美国今年真的受到更严重的打击吗？

items.summary: Let's shield the astronauts instead of the spacecraft.

items.title: Researchers uncover hidden pore network within nuclear fuel
items.summary: New understanding of how nuclear fuel breaks down and changes in an operating nuclear reactor could help keep some reactors running longer, will inform the next generation of nuclear reactor fuel systems.
items.zh: 研究人员发现核燃料中隐藏的孔隙网络

items.title: These mammal ancestors birthed live young far earlier than thought
items.summary: Growth rings on a fossil bone suggest at least one mammal ancestor gave birth to live young rather than laying eggs 236 million years ago.
items.zh: 这些哺乳动物祖先的出生时间比想象的要早得多

items.summary: “It’s the strongest evidence yet that particles dominated by a glueball component can exist in nature.”
items.zh: 物理学家终于发现了胶球吗？新证据表明是的。

items.title: MIT selected to lead new NSF materials research center
items.summary: The Materials Research Science and Engineering Center unites researchers across disciplines to develop technologies for medical imaging, sustainable metals production, and next-generation electronics.
items.zh: 麻省理工学院被选为 NSF 新材料研究中心的领导者

items.title: Estrogen therapy is linked to fewer signs of Alzheimer’s in the brain
items.summary: Estrogen-only menopause therapy in older women was linked to less Alzheimer’s brain pathology at autopsy but may not prevent the disease.
items.zh: 雌激素治疗与大脑中阿尔茨海默病症状的减少有关

items.title: A vest tested on the Artemis I mission blocked some radiation exposure
items.summary: A 26-kilogram plastic garment, flown on a model human torso on the uncrewed Artemis I mission, may one day protect astronauts from solar storms.
items.zh: 在阿耳忒弥斯一号任务中测试的背心可以阻挡一些辐射暴露

items.title: Astronomers discover a brand-new type of astrophysical object: A black hole star
items.summary: The mashup of a black hole and an enormous star has never been seen before and could explain the mysterious little red dots often found in deep-space images.
items.zh: 天文学家发现了一种全新的天体物理物体：黑洞星

items.summary: In the lab, female frogs were less likely to choose preferred males as mating calls increased, potentially giving other males a better shot.
items.zh: 太多的选择使雌性青蛙的性生活变得复杂

items.title: Graduate Student Proves a Quantum Uncertainty Principle for Fractals
items.summary: The math, which combines chaos, quantum theory, and infinitely complex fractal structures, has been called a “foundational result.” The post Graduate Student Proves a Quantum Uncertainty Principle for Fractals first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.zh: 研究生证明了分形的量子不确定性原理

items.summary: Researchers have found a clever new way to map a part of Earth’s upper atmosphere that is notoriously difficult to observe. items.zh: 成人大脑的自我修复能力比科学家想象的更好

items.summary: In a recent study, evolution gets even messier than usual.
items.zh: 粪便是否促进了复杂动物的进化？

items.summary: Keratin extracted from sheep’s wool helped damaged bone regenerate in animals, producing tissue that was more organized and structurally similar to healthy bone than tissue grown with conventional collagen scaffolds. items.zh: 由电子组成的奇怪晶体刚刚揭示了它隐藏的运动

items.summary: A new online platform helps engineers look beyond survival mode when designing habitats for extreme living conditions.
